@staticmethod
    def _occ3_pin_mask(logits, lengths, row_starts, pin, row_batch):
        """OCC-3 per-row pin: force [start, start+count) into the top-k.

        ``pin`` is ``ForwardBatch.occ3_dsa_pin`` = (start, count, forced),
        int32 device tensors with one entry per batch row (occ3_sglang.dsa_pin).
        ``row_batch`` maps each logits row to its batch row, the same expansion
        ``lengths`` uses. Rows with count 0 (every ordinary request, padded and
        free graph slots) write their own gathered value back, so their logits
        stay bitwise unchanged. ``forced`` receives the per-batch-row maximum of
        forced lanes. Fixed shapes, no host sync, no data-dependent branch:
        CUDA-graph safe. Columns use the init-token space: row_starts + position.
        """
        start, count, forced = pin
        rows = logits.shape[0]
        row_batch = row_batch[:rows].long().clamp(0, start.shape[0] - 1)
        lengths = lengths.reshape(-1)[:rows].to(torch.int32)
        start_r = start.index_select(0, row_batch)
        count_r = count.index_select(0, row_batch)
        lanes = torch.arange(128, dtype=torch.int32, device=logits.device)[None, :]
        base = start_r
        if row_starts is not None:
            base = base + row_starts[:rows].to(torch.int32)
        width = logits.shape[-1] - 1
        idx = (base[:, None] + lanes).clamp(0, width)
        valid = (lanes < count_r[:, None]) & ((start_r[:, None] + lanes) < lengths[:, None])
        idx0 = base.clamp(0, width)[:, None]
        valid0 = valid[:, :1]
        idx = torch.where(valid, idx, idx0)
        inf = torch.full_like(logits[:, :1], float("inf"))
        fill0 = torch.where(valid0, inf, logits.gather(1, idx0.long()))
        src = torch.where(valid, inf.expand(-1, idx.shape[1]), fill0.expand(-1, idx.shape[1]))
        logits.scatter_(1, idx.long(), src)
        hits = valid.sum(dim=1).to(forced.dtype)
        forced.scatter_reduce_(0, row_batch, hits, reduce="amax", include_self=True)
        return logits

    @staticmethod
    def _occ3_paged_row_batch(rows, next_n, device):
        """Logits row -> batch row for paged decode/verify/draft-extend rows.

        Every request carries the same static number of query rows there
        (1, or the draft-token width ``next_n``), exactly as seqlens_expand
        builds ``seqlens_expanded``; host ints only, so capture-stable.
        Padding rows past the batch clamp to the last row and are no-ops
        because their causal length guard or count is 0 in graph slots.
        """
        return torch.arange(rows, device=device) // max(int(next_n), 1)

    def _mask_init_and_local_tokens(
        self,
        logits: torch.Tensor,
        lengths: torch.Tensor,
        row_starts: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
        pin=None,
        row_batch=None,
    ):
        if pin is not None and row_batch is not None:
            self._occ3_pin_mask(logits, lengths, row_starts, pin, row_batch)
        if self.num_init_tokens == 0 and self.num_local_tokens == 0:
            return logits

occ3_pin = getattr(forward_batch, "occ3_dsa_pin", None)
        self._mask_init_and_local_tokens(
            logits,
            seqlens_32,
            pin=occ3_pin,
            row_batch=(
                None
                if occ3_pin is None
                else self._occ3_paged_row_batch(logits.shape[0], next_n, logits.device)
            ),
        )

self._mask_init_and_local_tokens(
                logits,
                seq_lens_expanded,
                ks,
                pin=getattr(forward_batch, "occ3_dsa_pin", None),
                row_batch=token_to_batch_idx,
            )

self._mask_init_and_local_tokens(
                logits_chunk,
                lengths_chunk,
                ks[start:end],
                pin=getattr(forward_batch, "occ3_dsa_pin", None),
                row_batch=(
                    None if token_to_batch_idx is None else token_to_batch_idx[start:end]
                ),
            )
